checks.message: Environment updates can modify infrastructure across all services deployed in it
checks.context: Proton environments define shared infrastructure. Updating the template version or parameters can trigger changes to VPCs, subnets, and security groups that affect all services in the environment.

checks.message: Service instance updates trigger infrastructure changes that may cause brief downtime
checks.context: Proton applies the updated template via CloudFormation. If the template changes compute resources or networking, the service instance may experience brief disruption.
